newsitem.title: UK: British designer to launch fumble-free condom.
newsitem.headline: British designer to launch fumble-free condom.

text.p: A British designer has developed a fumble-free condom that will be launched next month, a newspaper said on Sunday.
Monaco-based millionaire Keith Jones has been working on the Topaz, a user-friendly condom which features a special applicator, for six years.
He told The Sunday Times he wanted to maintain that "passionate moment" with "a condom you could slip on without losing eye contact with your partner."
"I also wanted something that you could not put on the wrong way, even in the dark," he said.
The new applicator makes the user remove the air from the device as it is removed from the packet.
The Family Planning Association confirmed that many men put condoms on inside out or complain they are too short or small "because they don't know how to use them properly."
The new project is funded by the French government and the Monaco Development Board, the newspaper added.
